# Skillsmith

> Create, test and vet SKILL.md skills for any coding agent. Skillsmith (`skillsmith`) scaffolds an Agent Skill from a template, checks it against the rules agents rely on (frontmatter name and description, a title, a trigger, steps, a size limit, no absolute paths), and checks an untrusted skill inside an E2B microVM before you install it. It ships a CLI (`skillsmith`), an MCP server (`skillsmith-mcp`, four tools), skills and a Claude Code plugin, and it improves itself through its own evals.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what it does, every command and MCP tool, the editing rules, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): overview, one-step install for every coding agent, quick start

## Skills

- [write-a-skill](skills/write-a-skill/SKILL.md): write a new skill that agents find and follow, then check it
- [vet-untrusted-skill](skills/vet-untrusted-skill/SKILL.md): check a third-party skill, in an E2B sandbox when possible, before installing it
- [audit-skill-library](skills/audit-skill-library/SKILL.md): check a whole skills folder and fix the worst failures first

## MCP tools

- [MCP server source](src/mcp/server.ts): four tools over stdio: skillsmith_init, skillsmith_test, skillsmith_validate_spec, skillsmith_list
- [Plugin manifest](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin (skills, sub-agents, hook, MCP server)
- [Gemini CLI extension](gemini-extension.json): context and MCP server for Gemini CLI
- [A2A agent card](.well-known/agent-card.json): name, description, skills
